body:
Don’t let this week be “business as usual” (or “worship as usual”). Address the issues of race, white supremacy, violence, and hate … You’ll find guidance here:

 http://www.livefreeusa.org/livefreesabbath/

And here’s a strong example from my colleague Rev. Dr. Jacqui Lewis of what prophetic preaching might look like this Sunday:
